outcome: characteristics of corona virus disease 19 infection in pregnancy
incidence of corona virus disease infection in neonates
cohort: 160 pregnant women presenting to Paropakar maternity and womens hospital from 1st September 2020 to 31st march 2021 with confirmed corona virus disease 19 infection
finding: The clinical presentation of corona virus disease infection in pregnant ladies is similar to the general population and there is no increased risk of vertical transmission to the baby.
mod_finding: Out of 125 deliveries 71 % of cases underwent cesarean section of which fetal distress was the most common indication.
